opus.problem: This clue uses a minor detail (Michal's goat hair on the idol) while a better-known goat story goes unused: Rebekah prepares two young goats so Jacob can pose as Esau, and the goatskins cover his hands and neck to fool Isaac (Genesis 27:9, 16).
